name: Wealthbox
description:
Wealthbox is a CRM built for financial advisors and wealth management firms. This connector brings your Wealthbox data directly into Claude.

Search and update contacts, review and add notes, and track opportunities across your pipeline. Manage projects and workflow templates, and look up or create tasks. Check calendar events and meetings tied to any client. Work with the custom objects and custom fields specific to your firm, add comments and tags to keep records organized, link related contacts together, and look up users, teams, and workspaces across your organization.

Built for financial advisors, enterprise RIA firms, and broker-dealers already running client relationships in Wealthbox. Ask Claude to prep for a client meeting, follow up on a deal, or update a record, and it works directly against your live CRM data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Wealthbox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Wealthbox to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.crmworkspace.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Wealthbox MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wealthbox lists 67 MCP tools, including AddRelatedContact, AddTag, CreateComment, CreateContact, CreateCustomObject, CreateEvent, CreateNote, CreateOpportunity, CreateProject, CreateTag, CreateTask, and CreateWorkflow.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Wealthbox?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Wealthbox in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Wealthbox requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Wealthbox is developed by Wealthbox. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
